content:
maya: Quick heads-up — I ran a tiny link/snippet audit on the runtime-config KB page and found two low-risk issues we should patch: 1) example curl points at the old host (api.redwood-inference.dev) 2) the anchor used by the crosslink to the KV cache section is #kv-cache-v2 but the section was renamed to #kv-cache-v3. Link: https://kb.internal.redwood/runtime-config. I can open a small PR but want someone to be the doc keeper to merge and verify the onboarding change too.
sam: can you paste the offending snippet here so i can eyeball?
maya: sure — here's the example as currently rendered:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.dev/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-small", "prompt": "hello"}'
```
Suggested minimal fix: replace host and update curl path if needed:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-small", "prompt": "hello"}'
```
Also the crosslink in the "Caching" subsection points to `#kv-cache-v2` — should become `#kv-cache-v3`.
juan: I can take ownership of this doc patch + merge. please assign to me and i'll open the PR.
maya: awesome, assigning to @juan now and i'll add a one-line test checklist.
nate: quick flag — the same curl host is used in the onboarding repo's quickstart script (redwood/onboarding-scripts). If we change the docs example we should open a follow-up issue to update that script too so new hires don't copy the old host.
maya: good call. @nate can you create the issue in onboarding-scripts? i'll reference it from the docs PR.
nate: done — issue created: https://github.com/redwood/onboarding-scripts/issues/42 (title: onboarding: update runtime example host). linking it in the PR.
pr-bot: New PR suggestion: branch `docs/patch/runtime-curl-fix` created by juan, base `main`. Status: draft. (auto-note)
juan: Working on the PR now — branch `docs/patch/runtime-curl-fix`. Plan: update curl host + anchor, add a changelog line and a short test: `curl` the endpoint with a dry-run header to verify 3xx/200. ETA ~2h.
maya: perfect — ping me for review when ready. :thumbsup:
